details: For $n\ge2$; the domain has $n+\lceil\log n\rceil$ points.
proof: The class consists of the empty concept, $\lceil\log n\rceil$ tag singletons, and $n$ tagged concepts, hence has $n+\lceil\log n\rceil+1$ concepts.  Substitution into the definition yields the stated expression.
name: Log Size Ratio of Tagged Singletons
